questions.answer: Declare a parameter of type `Response` in the path operation function and set the header on it, e.g. `response.headers["X-Request-Source"] = "docs"`; the framework copies these headers into the final response.[1]

questions.answer: Add a parameter of type `BackgroundTasks` to your endpoint function and register the function with `background_tasks.add_task(...)`. [1]

Use `Query` with `min_length` and `max_length` to limit the length of a string query parameter, e.g., `q: Annotated[str, Query(min_length=3, max_length=50)]`. [1]
